commits.message:
fix(ci): bound every job, and fail any job without a timeout-minutes (rich-workflows-1qvg)

Review of #339: node-floor, publish and both deploy jobs were still on
GitHub's 6-hour default. Each job now carries its own bound, and
test/seam/workflow-pins.ts reports any job without one.
fix(ci): bound every gate-running job at 20 minutes, so a stalled apt mirror fails in minutes instead of 6 hours (rich-workflows-1qvg)

fix(deploy): one concurrency group per docs slot (rich-workflows-ui0d) (#336)

* fix(deploy): one concurrency group per docs slot, so a PR run cannot cancel a pending master deploy (rich-workflows-ui0d)

* fix(deploy): state what the multiplexer guarantees on a cross-slot race, against v1.1.0 (rich-workflows-ui0d)

* fix(deploy): key the concurrency group by the one computed slot, pin multiplexer v1.1.0, cancel superseded runs (rich-workflows-ui0d)

Review (high): the group re-derived the slot beside the step that computed
it; a slot job's output now feeds the group, VITEPRESS_BASE and version:.
The safety argument rests on v1.1.0's stale-tip rebuild, so the pin says
v1.1.0. test/seam/deploy-slot.test.ts fails a group not keyed by version:.
